card.name: Omega-3 fish oil wording and amounts
card.fires_on: Small words and spaces in omega-3 fish oil text, such as the gap before a gram amount or 'from the' / 'of' before 'oil of fish'. It also appears in nutrient lists.

modes.label: Before an amount
modes.description: The space just before a number of grams or mg after an omega-3 or fatty acid name.
modes.example: Supplemental intake of omega-3 fatty acids such as DHA exceeding<< >>2 grams per day is not recommended.

modes.label: Source of the oil
modes.description: Linking words such as of, from, the in phrases saying the esters are obtained from fish oil.
modes.example: obtained from<< the>> oil of fish. It is not known

modes.label: Nutrient list
modes.description: The space after a fatty acid name and colon before its amount in an ingredient list.

card.plain: It fires on little linking words and spaces in fish oil and omega-3 descriptions, just before the source or amount.
